feedback: I graded the single document at the capstone link, and the honest situation is that only D4 was submitted. The file is a readable .docx titled 'D4 - ETHICS STANCE' with no embedded links to a findings catalogue, exploit chain, or report, so D1, D2, and D3 are absent rather than unreadable. For D1 there is no findings table, so none of the ten vulnerabilities are documented; you needed the SQL injection in login.php (A03/CWE-89) with the captured 02:15:31 admin' OR '1'='1 line, the alg:none JWT acceptance (A07/CWE-347), the hardcoded secret sankofa-legacy-admin-2019 (CWE-798), the stored XSS cookie beacon at 02:18:47, the XXE in 04-import-xxe.xml, the path traversal at 02:24:02, and the safe-construct decoy proved with hash_equals being constant time, each tied to a quoted evidence line. For D2 there is no exploit chain and no CVSS, so the row scores zero; you needed the ordered hops recon 02:14:08 through file read 02:24:02 with verbatim PoC and complete vectors such as SQLi AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N at roughly 9.1, plus the 312-customer impact summing to tens of millions of naira tied to BoltCash. For D3 there is no executive summary, threat model, remediation ordering, or detection stopgaps, so it also scores zero. D4 is the only real work and it is genuinely your own voice, which is a strength; you handle the journalist carefully by keeping to high-level facts and refusing raw logs or internal names, you commit to not altering the timeline even if a senior looks bad, and you state the one action you take regardless of management, which is to escalate and preserve forensic evidence. What holds D4 back is that you cite ISC2 only loosely as 'protect people and public trust first' without naming a canon by number, and you describe breach notification generically without naming the NDPA 2023 by section, specifically section 40 to notify the NDPC within 72 hours and section 41 to notify the 312 affected data subjects on high risk. I looked hard for a way to round this up, but with three of the four deliverables missing the evidence simply is not there to support a higher mark, and I did not apply a fabrication penalty because you invented nothing. The single most important fix is to actually submit D1, D2, and D3, because a strong ethics stance alone cannot carry a capstone that is scored mostly on the technical findings, exploit chain, and report.
